edits.with:
tools.innerHTML='<button class="bkmode" data-v="stack">Stack</button>'+
                    '<button class="bkmode" data-v="quiz">List</button>'+
                    '<button class="bkmode" data-v="review">Review</button>'+
                    '<button class="bkall">Reveal all</button>';

<style id="ax-s116">
/* ============ s116: practice questions as an overlapped stack (Jonathan 2026-10-07). Stack | List | Review; Reveal all
   only in List. Tier tables: the tier column is a flat small-caps tag, the same as spine row tags. ============ */
.bankwrap.stack .mcqwrap{position:relative;padding-bottom:18px}
.bankwrap.stack .mcqwrap > .mcq{display:none}
.bankwrap.stack .mcqwrap > .mcq.sk-cur{display:block;position:relative;z-index:3;margin:0}
.bankwrap.stack .mcqwrap::before,.bankwrap.stack .mcqwrap::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:14px;right:14px;bottom:9px;height:48px;border-radius:var(--r-sub);background:var(--raised);box-shadow:var(--e2);z-index:2}
.bankwrap.stack .mcqwrap::after{left:28px;right:28px;bottom:0;z-index:1;opacity:.75}
.bankwrap.stack .mcqwrap[data-more="1"]::after,.bankwrap.stack .mcqwrap[data-more="0"]::after,.bankwrap.stack .mcqwrap[data-more="0"]::before{display:none}
.bankwrap.stack .mcqwrap[data-more="0"]{padding-bottom:0}
.bankwrap.stack .mcqwrap[data-more="1"]{padding-bottom:9px}
.bknav{display:none}
.bankwrap.stack .bknav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin:14px 0 0}
.bknav button{all:unset;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-height:42px;padding:0 18px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--raised);box-shadow:var(--e2);font:750 13.5px/1 var(--sans);color:var(--ink)}
.bknav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}
.bknav button[disabled]{cursor:default;box-shadow:none;background:transparent;color:var(--muted)}
.bknav button.next-ready{background:var(--accent);color:var(--raised)}
.bknav .bkn{font:700 12.5px/1 var(--sans);letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--muted)}
.bankwrap.stack .bkall,.bankwrap.review .bkall{display:none}
.bankwrap.stack .mcq.sk-in-f{animation:skf .3s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.25,1)}
.bankwrap.stack .mcq.sk-in-b{animation:skb .3s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.25,1)}
@keyframes skf{from{transform:translateX(28px) scale(.985);opacity:0}to{transform:none;opacity:1}}
@keyframes skb{from{transform:translateX(-28px) scale(.985);opacity:0}to{transform:none;opacity:1}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.bankwrap.stack .mcq.sk-in-f,.bankwrap.stack .mcq.sk-in-b{animation:none}}
@media print{.bankwrap.stack .mcqwrap > .mcq{display:block;margin:0 0 13px}.bankwrap.stack .mcqwrap::before,.bankwrap.stack .mcqwrap::after,.bknav{display:none}}
/* tier tables */
.tierT td:first-child{width:9.5em;font:800 11.5px/1.35 var(--sans);letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--criteria)}
@media (max-width:640px){.tw table.dense.tierT tbody td:first-child{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.3;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--criteria)}}
/* phone table cards: a wrapped value keeps its left edge instead of running back under its label (Jonathan 2026-10-07) */
@media (max-width:640px){
  .tw table.dense tbody:not(.first) td:not(:first-child):not([data-label="Order"]){padding-left:92px;display:flow-root}
  .tw table.dense tbody:not(.first) td:not(:first-child):not([data-label="Order"])::before{display:block;float:left;width:84px;margin:0 0 0 -92px;white-space:normal;line-height:1.3;padding-top:3px}
}
/* one toolbar: view and task filter as two segmented controls on one row (Jonathan 2026-10-07) */
.bankwrap .bktools{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 10px}
.bktools .bkseg{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;padding:3px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--recess);box-shadow:var(--inner)}
.bktools .bkseg .bkmode,.bktools .bkseg.bkfilter button{all:unset;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;min-height:30px;padding:0 12px;border-radius:9px;font:700 12.5px/1 var(--sans);letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none;color:var(--ink-2);background:transparent;box-shadow:none}
.bktools .bkseg .bkmode.on,.bktools .bkseg.bkfilter button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--raised);box-shadow:var(--e2);color:var(--ink)}
.bktools .bkseg.bkfilter{margin:0;flex-wrap:nowrap}
.bktools .bkseg.bkfilter button span{margin:0;font-weight:600;opacity:1;color:var(--muted);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.bktools .bkseg .bkmode:focus-visible,.bktools .bkseg.bkfilter button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:1px}
.bktools .bkall{margin-left:auto}
@media (max-width:640px){.bktools .bkseg{display:flex;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box}.bktools .bkseg .bkmode,.bktools .bkseg.bkfilter button{flex:1;justify-content:center;padding:0 6px}}
/* mnemonics: each capital sits centered in the tinted column */
dl.rows.mnem > dt{padding-left:33px;text-indent:-33px}
dl.rows.mnem > dt b.mn{width:28px;min-width:28px;margin-right:5px;text-align:center}
</style>
</head>
